web.description:
## [​](https://docs.brightdata.com/datasets/scrapers/linkedin/introduction#how-it-works)  How it works
```
Your app  -->  Bright Data API  -->  Structured JSON
           POST /datasets/v3/scrape
           Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

## [​](https://docs.brightdata.com/datasets/scrapers/linkedin/introduction#what-the-response-looks-like)  What the response looks like
```
curl -X POST "https://api.brightdata.com/datasets/v3/scrape?dataset_id=gd_l1viktl72bvl7bjuj0&format=json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '[{"url": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/satyanadella"}]'
```

```
{
  "name": "Satya Nadella",
  "city": "Redmond",
  "country_code": "US",
  "current_company": { "name": "Microsoft" },
  "followers": 10842560,
  "about": "Chairman and CEO at Microsoft..."
}
```

# LinkedIn Scraper API
## Easily scrape LinkedIn data without worrying about being blocked.
```python
import requests
import json

headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer API_TOKEN",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}
payload = [{"url":"https://www.linkedin.com/in/elad-moshe-05a90413/"},{"url":"https://www.linkedin.com/in/jonathan-myrvik-3baa01109"},{"url":"https://www.linkedin.com/in/aviv-tal-75b81/"},{"url":"https://www.linkedin.com/in/bulentakar/"},{"url":"https://www.linkedin.com/in/nnikolaev/"}]
response = requests.post(
    "https://api.brightdata.com/datasets/v3/trigger"
    "?dataset_id=gd_l1viktl72bvl7bjuj0&format=json&uncompressed_webhook=true",
    headers=headers,
    json=payload,
)
print(response.json())
```

# Best LinkedIn Scrapers: Bright Data, Apify & PhantomBuster
## Python tutorial: scrape LinkedIn with a scraper API
### How to scrape LinkedIn posts
#### Step 1: Trigger the scraping job
```
1import requests
2import json
3import os
4

5# Hidden secrets read from environment variables
6url = os.environ.get("BRIGHTDATA_TRIGGER_ENDPOINT", "BRIGHT_DATA_TRIGGER_ENDPOINT")
7API_KEY = os.environ.get("BRIGHTDATA_API_KEY", "YOUR_API_KEY_HERE")
8DATASET_ID = os.environ.get("BRIGHTDATA_DATASET_ID", "YOUR_DATASET_ID")
9

10headers = {
11    "Authorization": "Bearer " + API_KEY,
12    "Content-Type": "application/json",
13}
14

15params = {
16    "dataset_id": DATASET_ID,
17    "include_errors": "true",
18}
19

20linkedin_urls = [\
21    "https://www.linkedin.com/posts/example-post-1",\
22    "https://www.linkedin.com_posts/example-post-2",\
23    "https://www.linkedin.com/posts/example-post-3",\
24]
25

26data = [{"url": url} for url in linkedin_urls]
27

28response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, params=params, json=data)
29

30try:
31    result = response.json()
32    print(json.dumps(result, indent=4))
33except json.JSONDecodeError:
34    print("Could not get valid JSON response:", response.text)
```

### 5. Posts Discovery by URL
#### Code Example
```
authors = [\
    {\
        "url": "https://www.linkedin.com/today/author/cristianbrunori?trk=public_post_follow-articles",\
        "limit": 50,\

    {\

```

### 6. Posts Discovery by Profile
#### Input Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-|-|-|-|
| `url` | string | Yes | LinkedIn profile URL |
